audit.why: Both layers already read Akali on all seven rows, matching packet.levelChart and the 53.22% win rate, and the difficulty grade (FAVOURED, 4/10) is consistent with it. No chart change proposed.
audit.corrected: Phase whys regrounded on Lux's real cooldowns so the rows say something specific, but no side or rating moved.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike was justified only as 'she has nothing left to peel with'.
audit.why: She does have something: Prismatic Barrier, 12s at rank 1 and 1150 range, which absorbs the front of your combo. It is the reason a first-item all-in sometimes fails, and it was absent from the entire page.
audit.corrected: Force the barrier before committing; the item spike is what beats one barrier plus her HP.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things: the page said to 'minion-block' Light Binding as if one minion were cover, and it never mentioned Illumination.
audit.why: Light Binding 'binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units' — it passes through the first and stops on the second, so standing behind a single minion still gets you rooted. That is exactly the mistake an Akali makes walking up. Separately, Illumination charges any target her spells hit and her NEXT ATTACK detonates it, so the auto is the second half of her damage and stepping out of her attack range after her spell lands denies it.
audit.corrected: Two minions in the line, not one; step out of auto range after her spell connects; force Prismatic Barrier before the commit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Light Binding as matchup-defining but gave no number.
audit.why: Light Binding is a flat 10s at every rank — one of the easiest cooldowns in the game to count, and the whole all-in schedule keys off it.
audit.corrected: 10s flat written in and used as the commit trigger in phases[1], dosFull[0], report[5] and report[9]; Prismatic Barrier 12s and Final Spark 60s added alongside.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] told the reader Lux kites 'using Speed of Light', and the early text said she has 'no dash or escape besides a speed boost'.
audit.why: There is no Speed of Light in her kit and no movement-speed ability anywhere in it — Illumination, Light Binding, Prismatic Barrier, Lucent Singularity, Final Spark. Telling an Akali to expect a speed boost that does not exist changes how she times the dive.
audit.corrected: Both removed; she has no dash and no escape, full stop.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer referred to Lux as 'his' and 'he'.
audit.why: Lux is female; the page reads as written for a different champion, which is the tell of a template.
audit.corrected: Fixed in every field edited here.

notes: Fabricated ability removed: wants.foe[2] read 'Kite backward using Speed of Light', and the early paragraph credited her with 'a speed boost'. Lux has no such ability — her kit is Illumination, Light Binding, Prismatic Barrier, Lucent Singularity, Final Spark, none of which grants movement speed. Second correction: the page told the reader to minion-block Light Binding, but Riot's text says it binds up to TWO units, so one minion is not cover — this is the exact mistake that gets an Akali rooted while walking up, and it is now stated everywhere the advice appears. Prismatic Barrier and Illumination were both absent from the page entirely and are the two missingInteractions flagged for this matchup. The full layer also called Lux 'he' throughout; fixed in every field touched. Charts were already consistent across both layers and with the packet, so no chart edits were needed.
